subject: Proof Test Success Criteria and Ownership Plan
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@fletcherretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Proof Test Success Criteria and Ownership Plan

Hi Emma — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth going into the POC:

Summary of what we heard (your notes):
- Objective: validate Redwood can serve interactive product-recommendation prompts with <200ms p50 and throughputs of ~30 req/s for peak windows.
- Data: subset of anonymized clickstream + product catalog (no PII).
- Success criteria: latency SLOs met in 2-week stress window, correctness measured by top-3 relevance > 78% on your eval set, and no security concerns on network / keys.

Proposed POC scope and timeline (attached POC-Timeline-v1.pdf):
- Week 0: infra onboarding (VPC peering + firewall rules) — owner: Fletcher infra point (you) + Redwood infra engineer (we propose Laura).
- Week 1: model-onboarding + inference tuning — owner: Redwood (Karthik) with dataset handoff from Fletcher.
- Week 2: stress window & metrics capture — joint run with embedding/caching configs.
- Week 3: result review & decision meeting.

RACI (attached POC-RACI-v1.xlsx) — high level:
- Infra network setup: R=Fletcher (Emma), A=Fletcher, C=Redwood (Laura), I=Sales (me).
- App integration (API calls & QA): R=Fletcher App team, A=Fletcher, C=Redwood (Monica/Karthik).
- Security review: R=Fletcher Security, A=Fletcher, C=Redwood Security (we'll loop them in if required).
- Procurement/signing: R=Fletcher Procurement (David), A=Fletcher, C=Redwood Finance.

Ask: can you confirm the internal owners on your side (infra, app, security, procurement) and whether the proposed 3-week cadence works? If procurement needs any specific docs up front, let me know and I’ll surface them.

Attachments: POC-RACI-v1.xlsx, POC-Timeline-v1.pdf, SLA-draft.pdf

Thanks — I’ll wait for confirmation and will book the kickoff once owners are confirmed.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Direct: +1 415-555-0192

From: Emma Li <emma.li@fletcherretail.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: David Cho <david.cho@fletcherretail.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proof Test Success Criteria and Ownership Plan

Thanks Vivek — this is helpful and matches what we discussed. A few clarifications and confirmed owners from our side: 

Confirmed owners (Fletcher):
- Infra / Networking: myself (Emma Li) — I’ll coordinate with our cloud infra team.
- App Integration / QA: Marcus Reed (marcus.reed@fletcherretail.com) — I’ve looped him in below for planning.
- Security: Jenny Park (jenny.park@fletcherretail.com) — she requested our standard questionnaire and short architecture diagram.
- Procurement: David Cho (david.cho@fletcherretail.com) — on copy.

Questions: 
1) On the latency SLO: is the 200ms p50 target measured at the client (Fletcher app) or at Redwood’s edge? We need to be explicit since client-side network can add variability.
2) For data handling: we will send a sanitized sample TSV (no PII). Can you confirm the preferred transfer method (S3 presigned or secure SFTP)?

Procurement note: David, we will need a simple 3-party NDA / MSA before data or keys are exchanged. Happy to have Redwood legal send a starter.

Also attaching our internal evaluation rubric (we’ll share offline) — happy to align once we see your PoC telemetry.

Best,
Emma
Emma Li
Head of Platform Engineering | Fletcher Retail

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@fletcherretail.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proof Test Success Criteria and Ownership Plan

Emma — great, thanks for the owners list and for looping Marcus and David. Quick internal notes and a small ask from our side: 

1) Latency SLO: Vivek — we should make the SLO explicit in the plan: 200ms p50 measured at Redwood’s ingress (i.e., post-load-balancer) AND a target client-to-edge budget of <=50ms to keep total under 250ms. Emma, does that split sound workable?

2) Data transfer: we prefer S3 presigned links into a temporary bucket we control (short TTL). If SFTP is required by procurement, we can accommodate — David, any constraints?

3) Infra owner on Redwood: Laura Bennett will be the primary contact for network peering and firewall rules. She’ll request a small connectivity checklist and an IP allowlist from your infra team.

4) Security: we can provide a short architecture diagram and a redact-friendly questionnaire for Jenny. We’ll hold off on keys until NDA/MSA is in place.

Next steps I’ll take:
- Draft a one-page runbook (kickoff checklist + firewall entries) and share by EOD Tue.
- Karthik will scope the model config and expected tokenization differences for your eval set.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: David Cho <david.cho@fletcherretail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Emma Li <emma.li@fletcherretail.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proof Test Success Criteria and Ownership Plan

Thanks — quick procurement perspective from my side: 

- NDA / MSA: we prefer starting with Redwood’s template. If you can send a starter by EOD Wed I’ll route it through our legal. Timeline: procurement review normally 3–5 business days for a basic POC MSA + standard terms.
- Data transfer / security: S3 presigned is fine. We will need an export control checklist and confirmation that no customer PII will be processed.
- PO/PR: for this POC we typically do a short engagement order (not a long-term contract). Once the scope is confirmed we’ll issue a PO — budget holder is Product (cc Marcus).

Please send the simple MSA + the runbook and I’ll prioritize.

David
David Cho
Senior Procurement Manager | Fletcher Retail

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@fletcherretail.com>, David Cho <david.cho@fletcherretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marcus Reed <marcus.reed@fletcherretail.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proof Test Success Criteria and Ownership Plan

Emma / David — excellent, appreciate the quick turn. Confirming actions and owners from Redwood side so we can lock the kickoff: 

Redwood owners and immediate deliverables:
- Laura Bennett (Infra) — will share the connectivity checklist and IP allowlist template by Tue EOD. (Action: laura@redwood.com)
- Karthik Iyer (Model/Config) — will produce a short-run config and expected metric collection schema by Tue EOD. (Action: karthik@redwood.com)
- Monica Patel (Integration/Runbook) — one-page kickoff runbook by Tue EOD and will collect contact info for your app QA (Marcus).
- Vivek (Sales) — will send a starter MSA/NDA and follow up on PO cadence with David.

Immediate asks for Fletcher:
- Emma: confirm Marcus Reed as App QA lead and provide Marcus’s best contact window for a 30-min sync this week.
- David: once the starter MSA is sent, can you confirm who on your legal team will review (name/email)?

Attached: POC-RACI-v1.xlsx (updated with Redwood owner column), SLA-draft.pdf

I’ll schedule the kickoff for Thu if owners confirmed — suggest Thu 10:00–10:45 PT. If that doesn’t work, propose Fri morning.

Thanks,
Vivek
